title: Clarify provider status and surface active endpoint details
goal: Make the Providers tab distinguish saved credentials from a tested connection and show the effective OpenAI-compatible model and endpoint.
context: Issue #367 starts task-oriented tab improvements. ProvidersScreen currently labels a saved key as Configured although no connection test has occurred in that screen; Settings owns the actual test flow.
forbidden_changes: Do not move provider execution or connection testing out of SettingsScreen/Runtime.
Do not display or log secret values.
Do not claim a successful live connection without a successful test result.
acceptance_criteria: A saved API key is shown as not tested rather than as a proven connection.
Missing credential, provider lifecycle error, and local mode have distinct statuses.
OpenAI-compatible provider shows its configured model ID and endpoint.
New visible status labels are localized in Vietnamese and English.
verification: Review the ProvidersScreen diff for accurate status semantics.
Run Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow on the PR.
Manually verify provider status against Settings test result on an iPhone; do not infer device success from CI.
recovery: Revert this single task commit if the Apple build fails or status semantics are inaccurate.
